summary.result: As a result, the heat pump COP was improved by 18 %. and retrieval heat was 8 Gcal, the retrieval rate of heat stored in aquifer was estimated at 63 %.
summary.background: In this study, a cold well and a warm one with the distance of 100 m were installed in the alluvial aquifer.
summary.method: According to the aquifer heat storage test which had been conducted from Aug. 31 to Sep. 22, 2016, warm water of $850m^3$ was found to flow into warm well.
